purpose: Pending evidence-review queue, not an impact ranking
limitations: Descriptions are untrusted evidence, not proof of outcomes.
Well-documented work may be easier to discover.
Related initiatives need manual grouping before final scoring.
Screening all authors is not equivalent to reviewing all authors in depth.
Nominations remain provisional until the unmatched sample is reviewed.
